description: E2: the Cinder Titan standing burning at the Ember Hollow's east side, at the head of his road - a world boss held by his territory (world.ashfell.cinder_territory, TitanTerritory: a giant he sees wakes him; he hunts to 135 m of the hollow and walks home whole). An arena encounter (no leash), its seat reserved within 200 m (reserve_seat) and his AI at the near tier within 400 m (lod_near_m), as the other titans'. He dies once (persist_death; forbids his outcome flag).
